const items = $input.all();

return items.map(item => {

  const d = item.json;

  const systemPrompt = [
    "You are an Institutional Regulatory Intelligence Analyst.",
    "Analyze the regulatory document supplied by the user.",
    "",
    "Return ONLY one valid JSON object.",
    "Do not return Markdown.",
    "Do not use code fences.",
    "Do not add commentary outside the JSON.",
    "Do not invent facts.",
    "Base the analysis only on the supplied document information.",
    "",
    "The JSON must contain exactly these top-level fields:",
    "",
    "document_metadata",
    "risk_classification",
    "impact_assessment",
    "risk_flags",
    "",
    "document_metadata must contain:",
    "title",
    "issuing_agency",
    "document_number",
    "publication_date",
    "document_type",
    "",
    "risk_classification must contain:",
    "regulatory_risk_level",
    "enforcement_probability",
    "monitoring_priority",
    "",
    "impact_assessment must contain:",
    "regulatory_burden",
    "economic_impact",
    "compliance_significance",
    "urgency",
    "overall_severity",
    "",
    "risk_flags must be an array of concise strings.",
    "",
    "Allowed regulatory_risk_level values:",
    "Low, Moderate, High",
    "",
    "Allowed enforcement_probability values:",
    "Low, Moderate, High",
    "",
    "Allowed monitoring_priority values:",
    "Routine, Monitor, High",
    "",
    "Allowed overall_severity values:",
    "Low, Moderate, Moderate to High, High",
    "",
    "If the document does not provide enough information to determine a value, return an empty string.",
    "Do not infer unsupported facts."
  ].join("\n");

  const userPrompt = [
    "Analyze this regulatory document:",
    "",
    "TITLE:",
    String(d.title || ""),
    "",
    "AGENCY:",
    String(d.agency || ""),
    "",
    "DOCUMENT NUMBER:",
    String(d.document_number || ""),
    "",
    "PUBLICATION DATE:",
    String(d.publication_date || ""),
    "",
    "DOCUMENT TYPE:",
    String(d.type || ""),
    "",
    "ABSTRACT:",
    String(d.abstract || ""),
    "",
    "SOURCE URL:",
    String(d.html_url || ""),
    "",
    "PDF URL:",
    String(d.pdf_url || ""),
    "",
    "Return the required JSON object."
  ].join("\n");

  return {
    json: {
      model: "kimi-k3",
      messages: [
        {
          role: "system",
          content: systemPrompt
        },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: userPrompt
        }
      ],
      stream: false
    }
  };

});
